Who we are

An institution built for the board, and the board alone.

EMA STAIR Board Services pairs the reach of India’s first publicly listed global executive search firm with 40 years of board experience, to make board composition a disciplined, independent exercise rather than a matter of habit. We find directors, evaluate boards and advise on governance, as one accountable partner.

Board work is mandated for thousands of companies, yet it remains largely unserved by any dedicated, independent institution.

Why EMA STAIR exists

Three gaps that personal networks cannot close.

01

The composition gap

Search, not courtesy. Seats are filled through personal address books rather than structured, independent search, and the annual evaluation every listed company must run is too often a compliance file, not a source of insight.

02

The capability gap

Both halves, in one place. Search firms treat board seats as an extension of CXO hiring. Governance consultants advise on process but hold no director talent. Neither party holds both the discipline and the network.

03

The ownership gap

India owned, board led. Global brands carry parent reporting lines and sanction sensitivity that governance sensitive boards find uncomfortable. An India owned platform turns that discomfort into a durable advantage.

How we close them  →

Led by people who have sat on boards, not merely filled them.

How we work

Method where the decision is still made by habit.

01Search led, not nomination ledWe advocate that board composition be a disciplined, independent search rather than a personal favour, while respecting the discretion the network has always provided.
02A pipeline already heldFrom a standing pool of several hundred sitting and aspiring directors, we can say within hours which two or three names fit a seat.
03Evaluation that is acted uponOur framework is built to produce insight, not uniform scores. Value is created only when the committee chair acts on the findings.
04Board hiring is not CXO hiringThe client meets only the candidate they are minded to appoint. We manage the search, and every sensitivity around it, with discretion.
The board universe

The full board universe, not the independent seat alone.

01Governance boardsGroup level structures spanning multiple legal entities under one family, sometimes constituted overseas.
02Advisory councilsNon statutory boards built for specific purposes, such as succession or a strategic question.
03Family boards and councilsIncluding the appointment of independent external members to the family council.
04Non executive directorsThe non executive, non independent seat, used where a candidate is conflicted or has exhausted tenure.
05Emeritus chairpersonsAn under exploited construct that has to be structured properly, with rights and remuneration defined.
06Those Charged With GovernanceAn evolving construct expected to have wide ranging impact, including pre audit engagement.

01Why board hiring is not CXO hiringA board appointment turns on independence, standing and fit with the promoter and the wider board, not on the line management credentials that define a CXO search. The brief, the references and the discretion all differ, which is why we treat it as a distinct discipline.
02The expanding board universe in IndiaBeyond the independent seat, Indian companies are constituting advisory councils, family boards, emeritus chairs and those charged with governance. Each is a separate construct that has to be searched and structured on its own terms, not borrowed from the main board.
03Making the annual evaluation worth acting onThe annual evaluation every listed company must run is too often filed and forgotten. Built well, it produces insight a committee chair can act on, with findings that change how the board actually functions rather than how it appears on paper.
Join Us

Board seats are filled from evidence, not address books.

EMA STAIR maintains a standing register of directors for India’s listed, private and venture backed boards. If you are building a portfolio career as an independent director, committee chair or advisory board member, put your profile in front of the partners running live mandates.

The director register

A standing register, read by live mandates.

Board seats in India are still filled largely through personal address books. We keep a structured, referenced register of directors so that when a nomination committee asks for a genuinely independent shortlist, the search starts from evidence rather than acquaintance. Profiles submitted here are read by the partners running those mandates.

01

Serving and former executives

Chief executives, finance, technology, risk and human resources leaders, and business heads ready to convert operating depth into board contribution.

02

Practising professionals

Chartered accountants, lawyers, bankers, actuaries and former regulators with the standing that audit, risk and compliance committees require.

03

Specialists in short supply

Technology and artificial intelligence, cyber security, sustainability and ESG, and family governance specialists that nomination committees are actively short of.

What we look for

Independence, committee readiness, and evidence.

01

Independence in fact and appearance

No relationship with the promoter, management or auditor that a regulator or a proxy adviser would question.

02

Committee readiness

Audit, nomination and remuneration, risk, stakeholder relationship or corporate social responsibility, and the depth to chair one.

03

Sector depth, and the evidence for it

Profit and loss ownership, regulatory exposure or transaction experience that maps to the sector of the board in question.

04

Bandwidth

Directorships already held, and the time genuinely available for papers, committee work and site visits.

05

Regulatory standing

Director Identification Number, independent director databank registration where applicable, and a clean disqualification record.

06

References that hold

Chairpersons, promoters and fellow directors willing to speak to your judgement in the room.

Submit your profile

Put your name forward.

Complete the details below and your email client will open with everything filled in. Attach your résumé and send. If you would rather write to us directly, use boardservices@emastair.com.

Your details are assembled into an email in your own mail client. Nothing is transmitted from this page, and no file is uploaded here. Please attach your résumé before sending.

Please read before submitting

Submitting a profile is not an application for a named appointment and does not create an engagement, mandate, retainer or obligation of any kind between you and EMA STAIR Board Services, EMA Partners India or STAIR Digital.

Board appointments are made by the board and the shareholders of the client company. We do not guarantee consideration for any particular mandate, an interview, or an appointment. We never charge directors or candidates a fee, at any stage, for inclusion in the register or for consideration.

Your profile is held in confidence. It is shared only with the client of a live mandate, and only where your background is relevant to that search. It is retained until you ask us to remove it. To review, correct or delete your record, write to boardservices@emastair.com.

What happens next

Three steps, no obligation on either side.

01

We read and index

Every profile is read by a partner and indexed against sector, function, committee readiness and availability.

02

We come back when it is relevant

You hear from us when a live mandate matches your background. We do not send updates you have not asked for.

03

Referencing before the client meets you

Where a mandate proceeds, we reference thoroughly and brief you fully. The client meets only the candidates the board is minded to appoint.

Shailesh Haribhakti

Chairman, STAIR Digital · Chairman, Shailesh Haribhakti and Associates
Shailesh Haribhakti

Shailesh is a veteran leader in corporate governance, risk management and Exponential Organisation strategy, with over 40 years of experience shaping India’s financial and business ecosystem across more than 20 companies, including Swiggy, Adani Total Gas and TVS Motor.

He serves as Non Executive Chairman, Independent Director and Advisory Board Member across multiple sectors, including finance, fintech, technology and ESG. A pioneer in Exponential Organisation transformation, he guides businesses toward 10X scalability through AI, digital transformation and sustainability.

He is a chartered accountant and a serial board chair, and continues to lead across education, technology, clean energy and financial services as Chairman of Shailesh Haribhakti and Associates.

Practices

  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
  • Board and CEO Services
  • Consumer, Retail and Services
  • Digital
  • Financial Services
  • Payments, Fintech and Transaction Services

K. Sudarshan

Managing Director, EMA Partners India · APAC Chair, EMA Partners International
K Sudarshan

Sudarshan is the Managing Director of EMA Partners India and part of the global firm’s executive committee, with over 25 years of experience in executive search. He has led successful domestic and cross border assignments for both Indian and multinational corporations across industry sectors and functional disciplines, and heads the firm’s Board and CEO practice, partnering with clients to deliver several high profile leadership appointments.

He is an engineering graduate of the National Institute of Technology, Kurukshetra and an alumnus of Harvard Business School, where he completed the Owner and President Management programme. He serves as an Independent Director on company boards and writes regularly in leading business media on general management, human resources and academics.

An avid marathoner, fitness enthusiast and amateur squash player, he is also an angel investor in emerging sectors including healthtech, HR SaaS and aviation.

Focus Areas

  • Exponential Organisations (ExO)
  • AI driven transformation
  • Venture investing
  • Technology policy and AI
  • Governance and capital

Shubham Saraff

Co Founder and Director, STAIR Digital
Shubham Saraff

Shubham is Co Founder of STAIR Digital, with deep expertise in Exponential Organisations, AI driven business transformation and venture investing. He is an MBA alumnus of Saïd Business School, Oxford, a former Chairperson of the Technology Business Network at Oxford University, and an Investment Partner at Oxford Syndicate Capital, focusing on ESG and technology based venture investments.

He advises the Managing Director and CEO of one of India’s largest listed fintechs and serves as CIO to a venture capital fund, its investee companies and startups, on future ready technologies, strategy and brand positioning. He was the youngest ever Board Advisor for Technology Policy and AI at the IET, the global technology body of more than 160,000 professionals across 150 countries.

With 10 years of research in AI, neural networks and machine learning, he has published in international journals and received the Best Research Paper Award by Cambridge and the IET Global Award. He is a TEDx speaker on artificial intelligence and human connectedness at Oxford and Bocconi, and a frequent speaker, moderator and jury member at technology panels.

  • Financial Officers

Gopinadhan KG

Senior Partner, EMA Partners India · India and Singapore
Gopinadhan KG

Gopi is Senior Partner for India and Singapore and leads the firm’s Bengaluru office. He directs senior general management and technical leadership searches across the Industrial, Energy and Natural Resources, and Supply Chain and Operations sectors in Asia Pacific.

Since joining in 2011 he has led executive search and succession planning mandates for listed, private equity backed and family owned organisations, and established the firm’s Digital and Consumer practices in India before returning to the Industrial practice in 2016. As Regional Practice Leader he advises clients across consumer, manufacturing, metals and mining, oil and gas, and renewable energy.

He previously held consulting roles across Asia Pacific, Africa and Europe. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering and a Master’s degree in Management.

Shreya Jain

Client Partner, EMA Partners India
Shreya Jain

Shreya is a Client Partner at EMA Partners India, working across board and CEO services, retail and services, media, private equity and professional services.

She joined from KPMG India, where she spent close to 15 years in consulting. Her work centres on problem solving, stakeholder engagement and long term relationship management, alongside brand and eminence initiatives.

She holds a Bachelor’s degree in Commerce from HR College, Mumbai, and a Master’s degree from SP Jain School of Global Management. Outside work she follows sport, travel, nature and music.
